# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `devsmooth` MCP server pointing at AI Chat for Website's hosted endpoint (`https://app.aichatforwebsite.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: references the publisher's hosted favicon; no local image file could be downloaded.
